therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: DNA synthesis and cell cycle progression
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA synthesis inhibition (clofarabine), topoisomerase II inhibition (etoposide), DNA alkylation (cyclophosphamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Achievement of Complete Remission (CR) at Reinduction

results.dose_information: Clofarabine 40 mg/m2/day IV over 2 hours days 1-5, Etoposide 100 mg/m2/day IV over 2 hours days 1-5, Cyclophosphamide 440 mg/m2/day IV over 30-60 minutes days 1-5
